steps.en: Write a class that extends LitElement and register its tag name
steps.zh: 写一个继承 LitElement 的类，注册标签名

steps.en: Declare reactive properties and return the markup from render()
steps.zh: 声明响应式属性，在 render() 里返回模板

steps.en: On each property change, re-renders and patches only the template's dynamic parts
steps.zh: 属性一变就重新渲染，只修补模板里的动态部分

steps.en: Scopes styles to the element's shadow root, so they neither leak out nor get overridden
steps.zh: 把样式限定在元素的 shadow root 里，不外泄也不被覆盖

steps.en: Use the tag in any page or framework
steps.zh: 在任何页面或框架里直接用这个标签

value.en: One component library that React, Vue, Angular and plain HTML pages all consume as standard elements
value.zh: 一套组件库，React、Vue、Angular 和纯 HTML 页面都能当作标准元素直接使用
